meta.label: Retrieve a list of authentication methods registered to a user
meta.description: Retrieve a list of authentication methods registered to a user. The authentication methods are defined by the types derived from the authenticationMethod resource type. A column containing Entra ID users userPrincipalName or GUID is required.

params.name: user_id_column
params.label: Input dataset Entra ID users column
params.description: Column containing Entra ID userPrincipalNames or GUIDs
